bridging.errata: Canonical set: 9 ordered LINK-pair configs = the 8 rows of docs/TRIGRAM_BRIDGING.md read as 4 mirrored anchor-bearing pairs (row 4 corrected to LINK(TARGET, ANCHOR) LINK(DESTINATION, ANCHOR)) PLUS one spare leaf-to-leaf config LINK(DESTINATION, ANCHOR) LINK(DESTINATION, TARGET). Owner errata (2026-10-14, verbatim, re row 4): "that's an error on my part. but having a spare d->a and d->t link is good." D->T (file before delete, per the list) is the set's one anchorless link, included by design; the role audit accepts this declared leaf-to-leaf link and rejects any other anchorless LINK.
carriers: The man can see the sea.
The cat sat on the mat.
All that is done is done, and all that is done cannot be undone.
The seeds fell deep and the seeds grew and the seeds grew tall.
The dog saw the cat and the cat saw the dog.
A good day is a day well spent, and a day well spent is good.
The sea sees no sun, and no sun sees the sea.
A good dog on a dark day is still a good dog.
The day came and the day went and still the man sat.
The rain fell and the rain fed the seed.
The dog ran and ran and ran.
The sun was warm, and the dog was warm in the sun.
The sun rose, and the dog sat in the sun.
It is what it is, and it was what it was.
Rain falls and rain falls as the dark rain falls.
A cat ran on a mat.
The deep rain fed the deep roots of the tall tree.
The cat and the dog sat still.
The tall tree grew green and the green tree grew tall.
The man saw the sea and the sea saw the man.
